Question: FR-023.1 says the list is filtered by brand, by "other levels" and by the person who builds the orders. Which other levels?
Assumed (screen drawn on this): Zone, state and dealer group, in that order, alongside brand and order builder.

Question: The child-location stock / MAX switches are defaulted from the dealer configuration (FR-014.7). May the order team change them for one run?
Assumed (screen drawn on this): Yes - shown switched to the dealer default; a change applies to this run only and is recorded against the order.

Question: How long does an order that was not generated on its day stay on the list (FR-023.3)?
Assumed (screen drawn on this): Until it is generated or marked Not Sent with a remark - it never drops off by itself.

Question: FR-023.4 flags exceptions separately from the uploaded data, but they are not defined. What raises an exception?
Assumed (screen drawn on this): A file older than the dealer's ordering day, a required column missing (Section 5.5), a location missing from a multi-location upload, and stock quantities that are negative.

Question: FR-024.4 allows the data to be validated manually. Who may do it, and is a reason recorded?
Assumed (screen drawn on this): The order team member who builds the order; a short reason is required and shown in the order history.

Area: Variance stock list format and validity
Question: Which columns does the variance stock file carry, and how long does a list marked "always" stay valid?
Assumed (screen drawn on this): Columns: part number, location, system stock, physical stock (difference worked out); an "always" list stays until it is replaced or cleared.

Question: How exactly do N1, N2, MAX, average sales and TDOS decide which parts are raised or reduced for an ad hoc order?
Assumed (screen drawn on this): Shown read-only on this screen; the rules are set by the Admin with the SOQ rules and only the target value and include / exclude lists are entered here.

Roles: Order team (order consultant), Sparecare sales team (FS / BDM / ZBDM), Sparecare operations team (OC / BM)
Question: FR-023.6 flags an order out of line with past orders. Compared with how many past orders, by value or by part, and from what deviation?
Assumed (screen drawn on this): Compared by order value with the average of the last 3 orders; flagged when more than 50% above or below.

Roles: Order team (order consultant), Sparecare sales team (FS / BDM / ZBDM), Sparecare operations team (OC / BM)
Question: Can anyone other than the order team approve or mark an order Not Sent - for example the zonal operations head?
Assumed (screen drawn on this): Only the order team approves; sales and operations see the list for their locations, read-only.

Roles: Sparecare Admin, Order team (order consultant), Sparecare sales team (FS / BDM / ZBDM), Sparecare operations team (OC / BM), Dealer SPM
Question: How do users sign in - password, a one-time code to the verified mobile / mail, or both?
Assumed (screen drawn on this): Password, with a one-time code as an alternative; dealer users mostly use the code.

Question: The Admin landing page was not discussed. Are these the tiles the Admin needs (orders today, dealers and locations, users, brands configured, failed notifications, recent changes)?
Assumed (screen drawn on this): Yes, as drawn.

Question: Should the order team land on a summary page, or go straight to today's scheduled list?
Assumed (screen drawn on this): A short summary page with the alerts, one click from the list.

Screen: WF-04 My Locations Dashboard (Sales and Operations teams)
Roles: Sparecare sales team (FS / BDM / ZBDM), Sparecare operations team (OC / BM)
Question: Do the sales team (FS / BDM / ZBDM) and the operations team (OC / BM) see the same pages, or do their rights differ?
Assumed (screen drawn on this): Same pages and data scope; neither approves orders.

Screen: WF-05 Dealer View - My Orders (Dealer SPM)
Question: Does the SPM use OGYS on a phone, a desktop, or only through the e-mail and WhatsApp messages?
Assumed (screen drawn on this): Mostly on a phone; the pages are drawn phone-first and work on desktop.

Area: Location not in the file name
Question: When the location cannot be read from the file name (FR-003.7, AI-002), how is it set?
Assumed (screen drawn on this): The order team picks it from the dealer's locations before upload; the file is held until it is set.

Question: Besides the required columns, should validation check values - negative stock, blank part numbers, duplicate rows?
Assumed (screen drawn on this): Yes - these raise exceptions (see CQ-04) rather than rejecting the file.

Question: How long are uploaded original files kept?
Assumed (screen drawn on this): 12 months, then the batch record stays and the file is archived.

Question: Which data does a non-scheduled order use when today's files have not arrived?
Assumed (screen drawn on this): The latest validated upload of each type; its date is shown and a warning appears if it is older than 2 days.

Question: Is the order sent automatically when approved, or does the order team press Send?
Assumed (screen drawn on this): Sent automatically on approval; Send here is for a resend.

Question: May the order team resend a failed message and change the recipient?
Assumed (screen drawn on this): Resend yes; the recipient list is changed only in Notification Management by the Admin.

Question: A PO matching no Sparecare order is held for the order team (analyst safeguard, FR-008.3). Agreed?
Assumed (screen drawn on this): Yes - held and linked by hand to an order and location.

Question: When is a dealer reminded that feedback is not done, and who else is told?
Assumed (screen drawn on this): Reminder to the SPM after 2 days; the sales team sees it on their dashboard.

Area: Meaning of "Type" in data upload settings
Question: FR-001.1 says data types are defined "per Brand and per Type". What is Type - part category (spares, accessories, oil), dealer type, or something else?
Assumed (screen drawn on this): Part category.

Question: When a dealer has its own mapping (FR-002.10, e.g. a SAP export), does it replace the brand mapping or add to it?
Assumed (screen drawn on this): It replaces the brand mapping for that dealer; everything else follows the brand.

Question: OEM files change (FR-003.6). May a required column be accepted under alternative names (e.g. PART NO for PART_NUM)?
Assumed (screen drawn on this): Yes - a list of accepted names per column, kept by the Admin.

Question: What is the sequence number in User Management used for?
Assumed (screen drawn on this): The order in which users are listed and assigned work.

Area: Who approves a request to edit
Question: FR-027.6: a request goes to the user above in the hierarchy or to the Admin. Which one, and when?
Assumed (screen drawn on this): The user above; to the Admin when there is nobody above.

Question: Which dealer contacts get a login - only SPMs, or others too (e.g. GM to see order values)?
Assumed (screen drawn on this): Only SPMs sign in; others receive messages.

Question: Are dealer codes generated by OGYS or entered from the OEM?
Assumed (screen drawn on this): The OEM dealer code is entered; OGYS keeps its own internal id.

Roles: Sparecare Admin, Sparecare sales team (FS / BDM / ZBDM), Sparecare operations team (OC / BM)
Area: Where mother and child locations are set
Question: FR-028.10: where are the mother and child locations of a dealer defined - at onboarding (NM setting) or in the OGS rules?
Assumed (screen drawn on this): In the NM setting at onboarding; the OGS rules use it.

Question: Does a bulk upload replace existing location data or only add and update rows? Is it the only way, or alongside the screens?
Assumed (screen drawn on this): Adds and updates row by row; alongside the screens.

Question: Pending PO = PO - MRN - STN Pending as spoken, or + STN Pending as in the workbook?
Assumed (screen drawn on this): Minus, as spoken.

Question: How is "within a particular time period" defined for an OOQ rule?
Assumed (screen drawn on this): A number of days counted back from the order date, set per rule.

Area: Extra PO numbers in the branch example
Question: In the inter-location example some branches carry extra PO numbers (A1, A2, B3 ...). What are they?
Assumed (screen drawn on this): Further company orders for the same branch; each is mapped to the branch.

Question: The Norm in the linked-family excess formula - days of stock or units?
Assumed (screen drawn on this): Days of average sales, default 0.

Question: The workbook lists price, excess days, non-stockable with no open job line, job card and CBO. Are they needed?
Assumed (screen drawn on this): Available as parameters, switched off until a brand needs them.

Question: When SOQ is zero or negative, is the line simply not ordered?
Assumed (screen drawn on this): Yes - no line is suggested.

Question: How are (stock + OOQ) days worked out, and where is the threshold set?
Assumed (screen drawn on this): (Stock + OOQ) divided by average daily sales; threshold at the same level as TOC settings.

Area: Option A or B by default
Question: Without a pending ITO list, is the default A (SOQ directly) or B (transfers first, SOQ on balance)?
Assumed (screen drawn on this): B for mothers that transfer daily; set per location.

Question: Confirm the price above which excess is still transferred (Rs 1,00,000 given) and the band for "reduce SOQ, transfer when needed" (Rs 5,000-50,000 given).
Assumed (screen drawn on this): As given, set per location.

Question: The list of feedback reasons, their default validity and how T-DOS validity works.
Assumed (screen drawn on this): Four reasons as drawn; two months default; T-DOS as an alternative validity.

Question: Can any order of the three sources be set, and how is "co-dealers where the discount is more" measured?
Assumed (screen drawn on this): Any order; a gainer is preferred when its discount is at least the set percentage.

Question: The thresholds for CBO days, MOQ value, line value and unit cost, and whether the dealer may change non-editable lines.
Assumed (screen drawn on this): As drawn; non-editable lines cannot be changed.

Area: MOQ rules and SOQ validation in scope
Question: MOQ rules and part-level SOQ validation come only from the reference document. Are they in scope?
Assumed (screen drawn on this): In scope, with the settings drawn, until the client says otherwise.

Screen: WF-24 Setting Master / Add New Setting
Question: Are the first set / sister set / overall sister of the auto approval setting the same as the sister hierarchy of the OGS rules?
Assumed (screen drawn on this): Yes - one structure, maintained in Sister Location Mapping (WF-50).

Question: When two location rules match the same part, which applies?
Assumed (screen drawn on this): The first in the list; the Admin orders the rules.

Question: The ITO allocation settings come only from the reference document and are partly blank. Are they in scope, and what else is needed?
Assumed (screen drawn on this): In scope as drawn; the blank settings left out until defined.

Question: Rule 4 of the OGS MAX and stock rules is blank. What should it be, or can it be dropped?
Assumed (screen drawn on this): Dropped until defined.

Question: Can a child location generate its own order independently of the mother?
Assumed (screen drawn on this): Only when "orders on its own" is ticked for it.

Question: Is the excess factor a quantity, a percentage or a multiplier, and is the highest-consumption location also where the order goes?
Assumed (screen drawn on this): A quantity; the highest-consumption location is only the planning reference.

Question: Which sheets and columns does each brand need, what are "AOP / TOC qty" and "Non_AOP_TOC_Order_to_OEM", and is the transfer e-mail sent per location?
Assumed (screen drawn on this): Columns as drawn for every brand; the TOC sheet off by default; one transfer e-mail per location.

Question: Which channels are in scope - e-mail, WhatsApp, SMS, mobile app, AI call - and what MIS and the One Pager contain?
Assumed (screen drawn on this): E-mail and WhatsApp now; SMS and mobile app later; MIS and One Pager with Monitoring.

Question: Does the dealer SPM give the feedback, or can the order team or Admin enter it for the dealer? Which reasons are on the list?
Assumed (screen drawn on this): The SPM, with the Admin able to enter it too; the four reasons of the feedback rules (WF-20).

Roles: Sparecare Admin, Order team (order consultant), Sparecare sales team (FS / BDM / ZBDM), Sparecare operations team (OC / BM)
Question: Which measures, levels, users and refresh frequency should Monitoring have, and is the One Pager part of it?
Assumed (screen drawn on this): As drawn, refreshed daily; the One Pager is a downloadable summary of this page.
